items.source: NamespaceHandler for Spring WebSocket configuration namespace.
items.translation: NamespaceHandler 用于 Spring WebSocket 配置命名空间。

items.source: A central class for aggregating information about internal state and counters from key infrastructure components of the setup that comes with @EnableWebSocketMessageBroker for Java config and <websocket:message-broker> for XML.
items.translation: 一个用于聚合来自带有 `@EnableWebSocketMessageBroker` 进行 Java 配置和 `<websocket:message-broker>` 进行 XML 配置的设置的内部状态和计数器关键基础设施组件信息的中心类。

items.source: Configuration support for WebSocket request handling.
items.translation: WebSocket 请求处理的配置支持。

items.source: Common abstractions and Spring configuration support for WebSocket applications.
items.translation: WebSocket 应用的通用抽象和 Spring 配置支持。

items.source: Support for annotation-based WebSocket setup in configuration classes.
items.translation: 支持在配置类中使用基于注解的 WebSocket 设置。
